lines.text: I am one of the founders and CEO of Airbnb.

When @MichelleObama and I were thinking about how to maximize our impact after leaving the White House, we landed on the idea of creating mentorship programs at the @ObamaFoundation. We wanted to invest in leaders around the world, just like people invested in us — helping them embrace broad perspectives, harness collective power, and drive meaningful change. We’re excited to introduce you to this year’s cohorts for our Obama Leaders Africa, Asia-Pacific, Europe, and USA programs. Some of them are students trying to find their place in the world, others are already on their way, with careers that span government, business, and civil society. But all of them have a shared commitment to create positive, sustainable change in their communities and around the world. They join the members of our Voyager Scholarship with @BChesky and Obama Foundation Scholars program with the University of Chicago, and we can’t wait to see what they do!

Every part of your trip is now the easy part. Starting today you can use Airbnb to: • Connect with friends and get inspired • Search in your own words • Get to know a neighborhood before you book • Compare homes side by side • Find helpful services for a smoother stay Not seeing something yet? Features are rolling out over time and may vary by location and device.

Today, @BarackObama, @MichelleObama and @BChesky, Airbnb co-founder and CEO, welcomed the fifth cohort of Voyager Scholarship recipients: 100 college juniors preparing for careers in public service. The 2026–2028 class represents 39 states and territories and 68 colleges and universities. Sixty-one percent of the cohort are first-generation college students, bringing even more perspectives and lived experiences to the Voyager community. Their work spans some of today’s most pressing challenges, from resilient infrastructure for island communities and water quality in the Great Lakes to accessibility policy for the Deaf community and the use of artificial intelligence in clinical care. Others are exploring graphic design as a tool for community engagement, first-time voter participation, food access in urban neighborhoods, and economic opportunity in rural and Appalachian communities. “Every year, this scholarship reminds Michelle, Brian, and me that there is no shortage of young people ready to take on hard problems,” said President Obama. “This year’s Voyagers come from small towns and big cities, from islands in the Pacific and neighborhoods here on the South Side. They are working on housing, health care, clean water, and public safety, and most of them started that work long before anyone offered to pay for it. We’re proud to help them keep going.” At the heart of the Voyager Scholarship is a shared belief that experiencing communities and cultures around the world can deepen understanding, build empathy, and prepare the next generation to create meaningful change. Along with scholarship support, summer travel funding, and personalized career coaching, Voyagers participate in monthly virtual sessions where they sharpen their vision for a career in public service, strengthen their bridge-building skills, and build relationships with one another. We can’t wait to see where their journeys take them. Join us in welcoming the newest class of Voyagers in the comments!

Just spent an amazing week in Mexico City with local Airbnb hosts, employees and partners. We announced a MXN 20 million investment to expand Airbnb.org’s Medical Stays program to provide free Airbnbs for families traveling to Mexico City for lifesaving cancer care and other specialized treatments for their kids. We also unveiled a free exhibition celebrating the history of the FIFA World Cup in Mexico, and an unbelievable Airbnb Experience hosted by the greatest Mexican football legend, @hugosanchez_9 And I spent a lot of time with our incredible community of hosts. 90% of hosts here have one or two listings. 65% are women or seniors. 73% are hosting just to make ends meet. These hosts are some of the highest rated in the world, and represent the best of @airbnb 🇲🇽
47 seconds of intel that will actually improve your summer travel.
Your summer trip just got upgraded: ✔️Boutique hotels ✔️Grocery delivery ✔️Luggage storage ✔️Airport pickups ✔️Experiences exclusive to Airbnb Oh, and car rentals coming soon 🚘

“Our view is talent and the possibility of being a changemaker doesn’t come in one form,” said President Obama to Voyagers, “it has to do with heart, grit, commitment, irreverence, and risk taking.” The world needs empathetic leaders who can build bridges and bring people together. The Voyager Scholarship provides access to a network of global leaders and mentors to help tackle difficult problems within communities and across the globe, together. If you are a current sophomore or community college transfer student ready to grow in your public service career, the Obama-Chesky Voyager Scholarship application is open now. Learn more and see if you are eligible to become a Voyager, link in bio!

EXCITING NEWS: Applications for the Obama-Chesky Voyager Scholarship are officially OPEN! 🌍✨⁠ ⁠ The Obama-Chesky Voyager Scholarship invests not only in academic success, but in making meaningful work-travel experiences possible and helping to bring people together across their divides. ⁠ ⁠ President Obama, Mrs. Obama, and Brian Chesky, Co-Founder and CEO of Airbnb, created the Voyager Scholarship because of a powerful idea: exposure to new places and experiences generates understanding, empathy, and cooperation, which equips the next generation to create meaningful change.⁠ ⁠ The #VoyagerScholarship offers current U.S. college sophomores or community college transfer students:⁠ 💰 Financial support to ease the burden of college debt⁠ 🌍 A summer work-travel experience to broaden perspectives⁠ 🤝 Access to leadership development training and a powerful network of leaders and mentors ⁠ ⁠ Applications are open until Mar. 17. Learn more, link in bio!⁠
Why @bchesky thinks that today’s AI models are more powerful than people realize

You belong in every room, and be shameless in asking for help, even from the president of the United States. That was the advice President @barackobama and Airbnb founder @bchesky , respectively, gave students from 71 colleges and universities during a conversation Monday with Foundation Executive Vice President of Programs Tina Tchen at an event at Home Court, one of the buildings at the Obama Presidential Center. “I believe in paying dues and earning positions of authority and leadership and responsibility. And so I don’t want to be overconfident, but you should never feel as if … maybe you shouldn’t be there because your parents didn’t have a college education or because you’re a woman or because you’re a person of color. Because the truth of the matter is, and trust me on this one, I can say that I’ve met every titan of industry and every global leader of every sort and all the wealthy tech guys, and they were your age practically when they started,” said Obama during the conversation with recipients of the Obama-Chesky Scholarship for Public Service. Later that day, President Obama met with students from @uchicago and @columbia who are part of the Obama Scholars program, to talk about global leadership and collaboration across areas of expertise.

From airbeds to 2 billion stays 🛏️ They threw three airbeds on the floor, built a website, hosted three strangers, paid the rent, and made friends. @airbnb was born. People told @bchesky the idea was crazy. Today it’s changed how the world travels. The lesson is simple. Start with what you have, test it in the real world, then scale what resonates. Curiosity and scrappy execution beat permission every time. 🙌🏽 #airbnb #startups #travel #techreels #interviews

latestIgtvVideos.caption: Excited to announce the Voyager Scholarship with @BarackObama and @MichelleObama. It will provide college students interested in public service financial aid, meaningful travel experiences and a network of leaders for support. Applications now open until June 14

Today, we’re introducing the biggest change to Airbnb in a decade. 

The new Airbnb includes:
-Airbnb Categories
-Split Stays 
-AirCover for guests

I’m working with Mila Kunis, Ashton Kutcher, and Ryan Peterson of Flexport to raise money for Airbnb.org and Flexport.org to house refugees and ship them relief supplies. Our goal is to raise $30M.

You can donate here: 

https://www.gofundme.com/f/stand-with-ukraine?qid=20c9dc3bbed8a6f79c84afa434651a12
